CAAnimation.doc: The abstract superclass for animations in Core Animation.

CAAnimationGroup.doc: An object that allows multiple animations to be grouped and run concurrently.

CABasicAnimation.doc: An object that provides basic, single-keyframe animation capabilities for a layer property.

CAConstraint.doc: A representation of a single layout constraint between two layers.

CAConstraintLayoutManager.doc: An object that provides a constraint-based layout manager.

CADisplayLink.doc: A timer object that allows your app to synchronize its drawing to the refresh rate of the display.

CAEDRMetadata.doc: Metadata describing how extended dynamic range (EDR) values should be tone mapped.

CAEmitterCell.doc: The definition of a particle emitted by a particle layer.

CAEmitterLayer.doc: A layer that emits, animates, and renders a particle system.

CAGradientLayer.doc: A layer that draws a color gradient over its background color, filling the shape of the layer.

CAKeyframeAnimation.doc: An object that provides keyframe animation capabilities for a layer object.

CALayer.doc: An object that manages image-based content and allows you to perform animations on that content.

CAMediaTimingFunction.doc: A function that defines the pacing of an animation as a timing curve.

CAMetalDisplayLink.doc: A class your Metal app uses to register for callbacks to synchronize its animations for a display.

CAMetalDisplayLinkUpdate.doc: Stores information about a single update from a Metal display link instance.

CAMetalLayer.doc: A Core Animation layer that Metal can render into, typically displayed onscreen.

CAOpenGLLayer.doc: A layer that provides a layer suitable for rendering OpenGL content.

CAPropertyAnimation.doc: An abstract subclass for creating animations that manipulate the value of layer properties.

CARemoteLayerClient.doc: A legacy class for cross-process rendering.

CARemoteLayerServer.doc: A legacy class for cross-process rendering.

CARenderer.doc: A layer that allows an application to render a layer tree into a Core OpenGL context.

CAReplicatorLayer.doc: A layer that creates a specified number of sublayer copies with varying geometric, temporal, and color transformations.

CAScrollLayer.doc: A layer that displays scrollable content larger than its own bounds.

CAShapeLayer.doc: A layer that draws a cubic Bezier spline in its coordinate space.

CASpringAnimation.doc: An animation that applies a spring-like force to a layer’s properties.

CATextLayer.doc: A layer that provides simple text layout and rendering of plain or attributed strings.

CATiledLayer.doc: A layer that provides a way to asynchronously provide tiles of the layer’s content, potentially cached at multiple levels of detail.

CATransaction.doc: A mechanism for grouping multiple layer-tree operations into atomic updates to the render tree.

CATransformLayer.doc: Objects used to create true 3D layer hierarchies, rather than the flattened hierarchy rendering model used by other layer types.

CATransition.doc: An object that provides an animated transition between a layer’s states.

CAValueFunction.doc: An object that provides a flexible method of defining animated transformations.

CAAction.doc: An interface that allows instances to respond to actions triggered by a Core Animation layer change.

CAAnimationDelegate.doc: Methods your app can implement to respond when animations start and stop.

CALayerDelegate.doc: Methods your app can implement to respond to layer-related events.

CALayoutManager.doc: Methods that allow an object to manage the layout of a layer and its sublayers.

CAMediaTiming.doc: Methods that model a hierarchical timing system, allowing objects to map time between their parent and local time.

CAMetalDisplayLinkDelegate.doc: A protocol your app implements to respond to callbacks from Core Animation for a Metal display link.

CAMetalDrawable.doc: A Metal drawable associated with a Core Animation layer.

CAAutoresizingMask.doc: These constants are used by the autoresizingMask property.

kCALayerMaxXMargin.doc: The right margin between the receiver and its superview is flexible.

kCALayerMaxYMargin.doc: The top margin between the receiver and its superview is flexible.

kCALayerMinXMargin.doc: The left margin between the receiver and its superview is flexible.

kCALayerMinYMargin.doc: The bottom margin between the receiver and its superview is flexible.

kCAConstraintMaxX.doc: The right edge of a layer’s frame.

kCAConstraintMaxY.doc: The top edge of a layer’s frame.

kCAConstraintMidX.doc: The horizontal location of the center of a layer’s frame.

kCAConstraintMidY.doc: The vertical location of the center of a layer’s frame.

kCAConstraintMinX.doc: The left edge of a layer’s frame.

kCAConstraintMinY.doc: The bottom edge of a layer’s frame.

CAEdgeAntialiasingMask.doc: This mask is used by the edgeAntialiasingMask property.

CATransform3D.doc: The standard transform matrix used throughout Core Animation.

font.doc: The font used to render the receiver’s text.

fontSize.doc: The font size used to render the receiver’s text. Animatable.

foregroundColor.doc: The color used to render the receiver’s text. Animatable.

string.doc: The text to be rendered by the receiver.

truncationMode.doc: Determines how the text is truncated to fit within the receiver’s bounds.

wrapped.doc: Determines whether the text is wrapped to fit within the receiver’s bounds.

levelsOfDetail.doc: The number of levels of detail maintained by this layer.

levelsOfDetailBias.doc: The number of magnified levels of detail for this layer.

tileSize.doc: The maximum size of each tile used to create the layer’s content.

endProgress.doc: Indicates the end point of the receiver as a fraction of the entire transition.

filter.doc: An optional Core Image filter object that provides the transition.

startProgress.doc: Indicates the start point of the receiver as a fraction of the entire transition.

subtype.doc: Specifies an optional subtype that indicates the direction for the predefined motion-based transitions.

name.doc: Returns the name of the value function.
